candidates.name: Spinal cord compression syndrome
support_spans: dorsal spine pain
gradually progressive motor weakness of the left lower extremity
spastic paraparesis with weakness of the quadriceps, hamstrings, ankle dorsiflexors, and toe extensors on the left
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and neurologic examination suggest a compressive lesion affecting the spinal cord.

candidates.name: Meningioma
support_spans: well-circumscribed, extra-axial mass posterolateral to the right side of the spinal cord at C7–T1
intermediate in signal intensity on T1-weighted images and homogeneously low in signal on T2-weighted images
candidates.why: The imaging characteristics of the lesion are consistent with a meningioma.

candidates.name: Neurofibroma
support_spans: marked canal stenosis and cord deformation
candidates.why: The lesion's location and effect on the spinal cord suggest a possible neurofibroma.

candidates.name: Schwannoma
support_spans: well-circumscribed, extra-axial mass posterolateral to the right side of the spinal cord at C7–T1
candidates.why: The imaging characteristics of the lesion are also consistent with a schwannoma.

candidates.name: Meningioma
support_spans: thin rim of enhancement with no internal enhancement on fat-saturated postcontrast T1-weighted images
candidates.why: The imaging findings, particularly the enhancement pattern, are decisive for diagnosing a meningioma.

candidates.name: Spinal cord compression syndrome
support_spans: Magnetic resonance imaging of the cervico-thoracic spine revealed a well-circumscribed, extra-axial mass
